query: How do I make a breakfast smoothie?

goal.title: Prepare a blueberry banana spinach protein smoothie
goal.description: Open the ingredients, measure blueberries and banana into a beaker, add spinach and milk, then add protein and collagen powders. Assemble and plug in an immersion blender, blend the mixture and pour the purple smoothie into a stemmed glass.
goal.final_state: A full stemmed glass of purple foamy smoothie is held toward the camera; remaining mixture and the detached blender shaft are in the beaker.

procedure.description: Approach arranged ingredients. Move the clear blending beaker forward, position blueberry and sliced-banana containers beside it, unscrew the milk carton cap and set it aside.

Lift and open the protein powder tub, set its white lid down and retrieve its scoop. Lift and open the green-lidded collagen tub, set its lid down and reach inside to locate its scoop. No powder is added to the beaker during this preparation.
Reposition the banana container, remove the yellow clip from the spinach bag, pull its top open and stand the bag on the counter.
Hold the blueberry container with the left hand and repeatedly transfer rounded spoonfuls of blueberries into the blending beaker. Return the berry container to the counter.
Lift the sliced-banana container and repeatedly scoop banana pieces into the beaker. Put the container down, lift and lower the beaker briefly and leave the measuring spoon in the banana container.

Reach into the spinach bag, lift a handful and put it into the beaker, pressing the leaves below its rim. Set the bag down, lift the open milk carton and pour milk in. Steady and briefly raise the beaker to inspect its layers, add more milk and return the carton upright.

Lift the open protein powder tub, fill its scoop and empty the scoop over the beaker, tapping out the powder before returning the scoop. Lift the collagen tub, fill its scoop, tip it over the ingredients and return the scoop and tub.

Lift and examine the filled beaker, put it back on the counter and screw the cap onto the milk carton. Retrieve the metal blender shaft and black motor, move the spinach bag aside, arrange the cord and insert the plug into the wall socket.

Join and position the immersion blender in the beaker. Hold its motor in the right hand and steady the beaker with the left. Press the control and move the shaft through the ingredients until the mixture is uniformly purple and foamy. Detach and put aside the motor, leaving the shaft in the beaker.

Lift and tilt the beaker, hold the shaft near its rim and pour the thick purple mixture into the stemmed glass. Return the beaker upright and put it down, lift the full glass and hold it toward the camera for presentation. No drinking is visible.

coarse.instruction: Arrange and open the smoothie ingredients
coarse.description: Move the beaker and fruit containers into position, uncap milk and open both powder tubs while locating their scoops. Remove the bag clip, pull the spinach bag open and stand it on the counter.
coarse.goal_contribution: Makes the ingredients and measuring tools accessible before loading the beaker.

coarse.instruction: Load the fruit and spinach into the beaker
coarse.description: Repeatedly scoop blueberries into the beaker, then transfer banana slices in several spoonfuls. Set fruit containers down, briefly move the beaker, leave the spoon in the banana tub and add and press down a handful of spinach. Put the spinach bag aside.
coarse.goal_contribution: Places the solid fruit and greens in the blending vessel.
coarse.predictability_reason: After arrange and open the smoothie ingredients, load the fruit and spinach into the beaker is a natural next stage toward prepare a blueberry banana spinach protein smoothie.

coarse.instruction: Add milk and powder to the smoothie ingredients
coarse.description: Lift the milk carton, pour while steadying the beaker, inspect the level and pour more. Scoop and empty protein powder into the beaker, then scoop and add collagen powder. Put the tubs down, inspect the filled beaker and recap the milk.
coarse.goal_contribution: Adds the liquid and measured powders to the fruit and greens before blending.
coarse.predictability_reason: After load the fruit and spinach into the beaker, add milk and powder to the smoothie ingredients is a natural next stage toward prepare a blueberry banana spinach protein smoothie.

coarse.instruction: Assemble and operate the immersion blender
coarse.description: Retrieve the shaft and motor, move the spinach bag aside, arrange and plug in the cord, join and lower the blender into the beaker and blend while holding the beaker steady. Detach the motor afterward.
coarse.goal_contribution: Turns the separate ingredients into a uniform purple smoothie.
coarse.predictability_reason: After add milk and powder to the smoothie ingredients, assemble and operate the immersion blender is a natural next stage toward prepare a blueberry banana spinach protein smoothie.

coarse.instruction: Pour and present the finished smoothie
coarse.description: Tip the beaker over the stemmed glass while holding the shaft near its rim, pour the purple mixture, put the beaker down and lift the full glass.
coarse.goal_contribution: Transfers the blended drink into its serving glass for presentation.
coarse.predictability_reason: After assemble and operate the immersion blender, pour and present the finished smoothie is a natural next stage toward prepare a blueberry banana spinach protein smoothie.
